item.title: Woman killed, boyfriend injured in Bay Point stabbing
item.description: A woman was killed and her boyfriend injured in a stabbing inside a Bay Point home Wednesday afternoon. Authorities are investigating the case as a homicide.

item.title: Avian flu infects more marine mammal species along San Mateo County coast
item.description: Following news this week of a southern sea otter's death from avian flu, experts are now saying the disease's outbreak has infected more species of marine mammals along the San Mateo County coast. The Marine Mammal Center in Sausalito said H151, also known as avian flu or bird flu, was first confirmed in seven elephant seals at Año Nuevo State Park, when they tested positive in February. item.title: Dublin schools' 4-day strike ends, union says tentative agreement reached
